{{recipe}}| [[Cookbook:Camp Cooking|Camp Cooking]]

'''Campfire s'mores''' are a classic snack and a favorite with children.  

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Graham Cracker|graham crackers]] 
*1 [[Cookbook:Marshmallow|marshmallow]] 
*4 squares [[Cookbook:Chocolate|milk chocolate]]

==Procedure==
#Toast marshmallow until golden brown over campfire on long green stick with bark peeled off. 
#Place on graham cracker, then top with chocolate and remaining cracker.

==Warnings==
*Be careful; when the marshmallows are ready they are very hot and can catch fire. Don't burn yourself!
